core_mechanic: A single seamless world streams around the player; progression is spatial discovery, not linear gating.
player_motivation: Make the unknown known on your own route.

essential_feel.traversal: multiple movement verbs (walk, climb, glide, mount) chosen per terrain
essential_feel.discovery: horizon landmarks promise content; payoff is visible from afar
essential_feel.world_persistence: player edits, kills, and weather persist across the session

pacing_profile.early: Tutorial valley funnels the player toward the first vista, then opens.
pacing_profile.mid: Multiple parallel quest threads; player picks the route.
pacing_profile.late: End-game zones gated by gear, ability, or knowledge.

progression_model.completion_definition: Main quest credits; map completion percentage and challenge zones extend play indefinitely.
progression_model.content_cadence: Per discovered region / landmark; player-driven, not designer-paced.

canonical_examples.title: Breath of the Wild
canonical_examples.what_makes_it_special: Every landmark is reachable from the start; gear and abilities just change the cost.

anti_patterns: Map markers that replace genuine exploration
Invisible walls breaking the climb-anywhere promise
Loading screens between regions in a 'seamless' world
